links.comparator_used: Five other OOD/failure detection methods compared head-to-head on the same deployed liver CT segmentation model (no no-detection arm)
links.outcome: Detection of segmentation failures/OOD cases (sensitivity, AUROC, balanced accuracy) on internal (n=400) and external (n=100, ~70 sites, 7 countries) data
links.effect: Pairwise Surface DSC: sensitivity 1.00; AUROC 0.97 internal, 1.00 external; balanced accuracy 0.94 internal, 0.88 external (p < 0.001)
links.quote: Pairwise Surface DSC was the top-performing method, with perfect sensitivities (1.00), near-perfect AUROCs (0.97 internal; 1.00 external), and the highest balanced accuracies (0.94 internal; 0.88 external;  p < 0.001).

design_hint: OOD/failure detection for segmentation with threshold selection
